rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something worthwhile, significant, or genuinely meaningful.

example.english: Volunteering your time to help people is really meaningful.
example.traditional: 你肯抽時間幫人，真係好有意義。
example.jyutping: nei5 hang2 cau1 si4 gaan3 bong1 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 ji3 ji6

rows.note: Use this for a smile, remark, or gesture that carries a suggestive or unstated message.

example.english: They smiled at me after saying that; it was very meaningful.
example.traditional: 佢講完嗰句說話再望住我笑，好有意思。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 go2 geoi3 syut3 waa6 zoi3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 siu3 hou2 jau5 ji3 si1

rows.note: Choose this when the unstated meaning is notably deep or deliberate.

example.english: They deliberately left a note, and there was a deep, meaningful message behind it.
example.traditional: 佢特登留低張紙條，當中有深意。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dak6 dang1 lau4 dai1 zoeng1 zi2 tiu4 dong1 zung1 jau5 sam1 ji3
